name: Irimu (Humanoid Form)
body:
IRIMU (HUMANOID FORM)
CR 3

Tall and sinewy, this individual has well-defined muscles that ripple beneath smooth skin. Their amber-flecked eyes gleam with quiet intensity.

XP 800
N Medium humanoid (human, irimu, shapechanger)
Init +3; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 10 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge)
hp 30 (4d8+12)
Fort +4, Ref +7, Will +2
DR 5/silver

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk spear +6 (1d8+3/×3)
Ranged mwk spear +7 (1d8+2/×3)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 17, Con 16, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 14
Base Atk +3; CMB +5; CMD 19
Feats Cunningvc, Dodge, Skill Focus (Stealth)
Skills Acrobatics +7, Handle Animal +8, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +5, Stealth +10, Survival +5
Languages Common
SQ accursed skinchanger, change shape (human, leopard; polymorph), feline empathy

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure standard (mwk spear, other treasure)

This is the humanoid form of the otherwise monstrous serpent creature.
